blocked.name: {name} (MCP off)
blocked.message: An admin turned off MCP connections for this workspace.

accessNotice.allProjects: The app can access every project in this workspace, including projects created after you connect.
accessNotice.transcripts: The app also reads meeting transcripts, including what attendees said and their names.
accessNotice.readOnly: The app only reads and opens screens. It doesn't change anything.
accessNotice.readAndTasks: The app reads, opens screens, and creates and edits tasks.
accessNotice.sameView: It can't see anything you can't see.
accessNotice.expiry: The connection expires if it isn't used for 90 days.

taskChanges.label: Allow task changes
taskChanges.effect: The app on this connection creates and edits tasks in your name without asking first. It doesn't change decisions or meeting reviews.
taskChanges.irreversible: You can't change this after the connection is created. To change it, connect again.

login.title: Sign in to connect an AI app to HeyMoa
login.description: After you sign in, you'll choose which workspace this app can access.

end.title: Can't continue connecting
end.reconnect: Couldn't find the connection request. Connect again from your agent.

consent.intro: This app is requesting access to a HeyMoa workspace.
consent.redirectTo: After you click Allow, you'll go back to {host}.
consent.noWorkspaces: There are no workspaces to connect.
consent.invalidRedirect: The agent's return address isn't valid. Connect again from your agent.

guide.label: How to connect with OAuth
guide.title: Which app do you use?
guide.description: The AI in the app you choose reads meetings and projects in this workspace. If the app asks to change tasks, you decide whether to allow it when you connect.
guide.allow: In the browser that opens, choose a workspace and click Allow.

claudeApp.openSettings: In the Claude app or claude.ai, open Settings › Connectors.
claudeApp.addConnector: Click Add › Add custom connector and paste the URL.
claudeApp.connect: Click Connect. In the browser that opens, choose a workspace and click Allow.
claudeApp.trouble: On Team and Enterprise plans, an organization owner may need to add the connector first. If you use Claude Code with the same account, this connection shows up there too.

claudeCode.authenticate: In your terminal, run claude, then choose /mcp → heymoa → Authenticate.
claudeCode.trouble: If it says heymoa already exists, remove it with claude mcp remove heymoa and paste the command again. If you connected through a connector in the Claude app, you don't need to add it here.

codex.trouble: If the browser doesn't open, run codex mcp login heymoa. If it says heymoa already exists, remove it with codex mcp remove heymoa and paste the command again.

chatgpt.developerMode: Turn on developer mode in Settings. <link>See which plans support it</link>
chatgpt.addConnector: Paste the URL into a new connector.

guide.done: Once connected, the app shows up in the list below
guide.noBrowser: Can't use a browser? <token>Create personal access token</token>
